'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Mean Jespar Mix LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mean Jespar Mix]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Mean Jespar Mix / rlx, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2010 form. Unread reserve lines: 12.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' rlx
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
